name: Gaddi
title: Spy from the tribe of Manasseh
summary: Gaddi, son of Susi, was the representative from the tribe of Manasseh among the twelve spies that Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He was one of the ten spies who returned with a negative report and discouraged the Israelites from entering the promised land.
relatedPersons: Shammua son of Zaccur, spy from the tribe of Reuben

keyEvents.title: Chosen as a Spy
keyEvents.description: Gaddi, son of Susi, was chosen as the representative from the tribe of Manasseh to spy out the land of Canaan at the Lord's command.

keyEvents.title: Sent Out to Explore Canaan
keyEvents.description: Moses sent Gaddi along with eleven other men to explore the promised land, examining the people, cities, and agricultural conditions there.

keyEvents.title: Exploring the Land for 40 Days
keyEvents.description: Gaddi and the other spies explored the land of Canaan for forty days, from the Desert of Zin in the south to Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.

keyEvents.title: The Negative Spy Report
keyEvents.description: Gaddi was among the ten spies who gave a discouraging report to the people, saying that the inhabitants were too strong and the cities too fortified for Israel to conquer the land.

keyEvents.title: The People's Rebellion and God's Judgment
keyEvents.description: As a result of the negative report from Gaddi and the other nine spies, the people of Israel rebelled against Moses and Aaron, and God judged that generation to wander in the wilderness for 40 years.

keyEvents.title: Death of the Spies by Plague
keyEvents.description: Gaddi and the other ten spies who had spread fear among the people with their negative report died from a plague before the Lord as punishment for their unfaithfulness.
